# Gerund and infinitive

## Core concept
A gerund is verb + -ing functioning as a noun: Swimming is fun. An infinitive often uses to + verb: to swim.

## How it works
Some verbs take gerunds (enjoy reading), others take infinitives (decide to read).

## What to watch out for
With some verbs both forms occur but meaning changes: stop smoking versus stop to smoke.

## Worked example
I enjoy learning English, but I want to improve my pronunciation.

## Try it yourself
Write a new example using the rule and explain why it works.
